description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function 'html_table' designed to generate HTML tables from an array of data, including various customizable attributes and layout options.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_table
methods.description: Generates an HTML table from a data array with customizable options such as columns, rows, attributes, and layout directions.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_table_cycle
methods.description: Returns the cycling attribute string for table headers, rows, and cells, supporting alternate styling.
